caveat: One repository of 520 lines. It measures whether the shape works, not whether the engine is accurate: two known vulnerabilities is not a detection rate, and libpng (the envelope checkout) has not been run.

degradations.detail: no path records; obligations evaluated within entry-point handlers only

open_defects.detail: app.py's permissive literal sits in . Its region is app.py:__main__, but Joern names the module-level method <module>, so the function filter matches nothing. It was reported eight times in the wrong files before the fix and zero times after: less wrong, still wrong.

VAmPI-SQLI: request parameter -> get_by_username(username) -> User.get_user(username) -> f-string -> execute. Source and sink are in different functions and different modules; regions are per-function and repository scans do not treat parameters as untrusted, so neither region sees both ends. This is the shape most real injection bugs have.

7 of 9 handlers entailed, including register_user and get_all_users, which are meant to be unauthenticated. At pair scale a guarded twin always existed; at repository scale 'unguarded with guarded siblings' fires on every public endpoint.
Access-control sites read api_views/users.py:?:update_password -- a location no editor can open.

reading: GO on one CPG per repository, NO-GO on region-scoped taint as the only shape. The engine handles a real checkout comfortably: one CPG for 11 files in 6.2s, every one of 22 regions arbitrated, 177s end to end at 869MB and $0.0067. Nothing here says a repository is infeasible, so phases 3-6 can be built on this shape. What it does say is that the region model has a ceiling: VAmPI-BOLA is entailed because the obligation and its absence live in one function, and VAmPI-SQLI is missed because its source is in the handler and its sink is in a different module. A per-function region cannot see a flow that crosses functions, which is the common real-world shape rather than an edge case.

known.weakness: SQL injection: the username is interpolated into the query string at line 72 and executed at 73
unauthorized password change: the path username is used instead of the authenticated token subject

what_this_run_changed.budget_no_longer_stops_free_work: The budget bounds model calls; it was enforced by breaking the region loop, so a paid limit stopped unpaid CPG arbitration. 6 of 22 regions were examined and the BOLA was missed. It now withholds the judge only: 22 of 22 arbitrated, 17 counted as regions_unasked, and the BOLA is entailed.
what_this_run_changed.queries_are_scoped_to_a_file: A region with no enclosing function sent function='' and matched the whole repository, and the driver attributed that answer to whichever region asked: one permissive literal in app.py became eight identical entailed findings in eight files that do not contain it. Queries now carry the region's file. Entailed findings fell 14 -> 7 and query time 70.9s -> 40.9s.
what_this_run_changed.the_batch_path_was_unreachable: query_batch had been implemented, tested and committed while CpgResult exposed only run, so the driver could not discover it and fell back to one JVM per region-family: the first attempt at this measurement ran 18 minutes on 520 lines. The earlier 275s->106s improvement attributed to batching came from region deduplication alone.
what_this_run_changed.the_jvm_heap_is_bounded: Joern with no -Xmx claimed a quarter of physical RAM; runs were killed under memory pressure at different points, so the numbers described the host. Now -J-Xmx2048m by default, OPENULTRASAST_CPG_HEAP_MB to raise it. This run was measured at 1536MB.
